correctness.rationale: Edge contractions give exact one- and two-edge probabilities for every n≥3. The Python 3 verifier independently enumerated n=3..7 with 47,656 exact rational checks; all-size validity rests on the analytic counting and decomposition.

value.rationale: The entire covariance geometry of all n(n−1) random directed adjacencies controls arbitrary weighted Hamiltonian-path costs. The boundary closure removes exactly 2(n−1) degrees of randomness, and the sharp n+1 variance ratio distinguishes additive vertex potentials from divergence-free circulations. This is a natural complete classification and optimal variance problem, not a numerical special case or restatement of single-adjacency probabilities.
